payload.title: Site and Department domain events carry no owner module in the TypeScript contract or the strict wire schema, and the gateway bridge validates raw payloads without an upcast step, so registry events cannot be routed by module and the field cannot be added without the bridge dropping events
evidence: libs/event-contracts/src/schemas/farm-events.schema.ts:682-685 (additionalProperties false: an unknown module field fails validation)
apps/gateway-api/src/websocket/farm-nats-bridge.service.ts:304 (validateFarmEvent runs on the raw payload; no upcaster registry is applied)
apps/farm-service/src/site/handlers/create-site.handler.ts:127-138 (the producer emits SiteCreated without a module)
payload.rule_violated: D1 keys registry rows by module, and contract rule C5 requires an event consumer to ship before its producers, which the current unversioned contract cannot do
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-16, release R7.
